originality.rationale: Emmons–Xiao establish eventual valuation periodicity and ordinary real orbit trichotomy, and later extend D_p to local fields with continuity and valuation discussion. The current theorem classifies closures of full integer-value orbits in Z_p, their disjoint balls, Haar measures and exact residue-class counts. The general principal-unit lifting lemma is standard and credited, but its application to each derivative valuation cycle produces an evaluated new orbit-geometric classification.
residual_risks: An implicit group-coset formulation in p-adic arithmetic dynamics may already yield the same closures or density classification.
Finite orbits and exact residue count require stated precision threshold; no claim for arbitrary Q_p starting point.

value.rationale: Exact p-adic orbit closure and modular density are natural dynamical invariants, complementing already-known real growth/valuation periodicity. Positivity of Haar measure for every infinite integer orbit is a useful structural phenomenon; the result is neither a trivial valuation renaming nor merely a computed small table.
